en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a park scene with a tennis court fenced in wood, set against a wooded hillside. In the foreground a young man in early 20th‑century attire sits on a wooden bench with a straw hat beside him. A winding path leads into the trees on the left. Printed captions at the top read "Piatra N." on the left and "Parcul Cozla, Tenis" on the right, with a handwritten number over the sky area.
